scope: All 1000 known CSS parsing mismatches remaining after the runner dependency-prefix exclusions, plus the three unexpected mismatches. Not a full browser or layout conformance audit.
method: Run the published revision CSS parsing WPT binary with HTML_WPT_ROOT and HTML_WPT_TRACE=1; retain the reported 1000 known and three unexpected mismatches.
Read every non-comment ledger entry, remove entries covered by the existing dependency-prefix exclusions, and join the remaining 1000 records to extracted trace arguments.
Join ledger ordinal N to trace ordinal N-1: the runner increments its ordinal reference before forming failure keys but after forming trace and ignored-run keys.
Probe all 871 declaration assertions through declaration_support and the pinned Lightning CSS Property parser in the same source snapshot.

For all 44 expected-invalid declarations reporting Supported, compare computed font, text, box, border, background and layout styles with a previous valid declaration, then with the candidate declaration appended.
Compare each of eight whitespace/comment clamp cases against margin-top:30px; also compare calc/clamp integer z-index cases against expected values.
Compare each of the three unexpected outline-offset assertions against a prior valid outline-offset declaration; all preserve previous computed styles.
The computed-style comparisons are probes of style resolution, not pixel rendering tests. No JS engine was used.

findings.issue: The supported-assertion count is not a renderer support count
findings.evidence: The runner excludes only Gradient and GeneratedContent capabilities explicitly. 471 of its remaining known mismatches already report Unsupported, and 400 report only a supported property name, not necessarily a supported value.
findings.action: Report syntax conformance and renderer capability separately; retain actual failures and classify them by capability and root cause instead of implying they are all implemented features.
Reject invalid declarations before they override earlier valid declarations, covering both stylesheet and inline style paths.

findings.issue: Valid clamp expressions are rejected when whitespace or comments precede a comma
findings.example: margin-top:clamp(10px,35px ,30px) falls back to an earlier value instead of computing to 30px. The equivalent expression without the extra whitespace works.
findings.action: Investigate and fix the pinned parser behavior; preserve CSS token semantics rather than removing arbitrary whitespace from raw CSS.

findings.issue: Malformed var/env calls are accepted by the syntax API
findings.cascade_result: All ten preserve the earlier computed style in these probes.
findings.action: Validate substitution-function grammar; substring presence is insufficient.

findings.issue: Valid CSS-wide inherit values are rejected by the syntax API
findings.cascade_result: Representative font-size and text-indent inherit comparisons match the expected computed values.
findings.action: Handle CSS-wide keywords consistently before treating Unparsed as invalid.

findings.issue: The nonfinite-math validation surrogate changes the result of range validation
findings.action: Keep syntax validation independent of stand-in arithmetic and range results.

findings.issue: Integer calc/clamp values for z-index are not represented
findings.cascade_result: The two representative controls differ from expected computed styles.
findings.action: Treat as an unsupported value family or implement integer math through the parser and resolver.

findings.issue: The three unexpected divergences share outline-offset length validation
findings.cascade_result: All three preserve the earlier valid outline-offset in the real cascade.
findings.action: Enforce dimensional validity in the syntax API instead of accepting permissive length-parser results.

findings.evidence: The InvalidSupportsImport expectation is already invalid. However, the pinned WPT helper creates an empty style element and checks its empty rule list without inserting or assigning the supplied rule, so its calls do not exercise the parser. Treating them as parser assertions invents a test contract.
findings.action: Report this helper as unsupported fixture execution rather than as a parser mismatch. The InvalidLayerImport helper does insert the supplied rule and has a different contract.

findings.issue: Computed and serialization assertions are checked only for input syntax
findings.evidence: 254 of the 1000 known mismatches have kind ComputedValue; the runner ignores expected computed outputs and serialized strings for these and the other expanded helpers.
findings.action: Keep parsing-only results explicit; use dedicated computed-value and serialization adapters before reporting conformance for those assertions.

findings.issue: Ledger and ignored-run ordinals use different bases
findings.action: Use one stable ordinal for tracing, ignore keys and failure keys, migrating ledger keys together.

findings.issue: A pure-length fixture conflicts with the renderer percentage-spacing extension
findings.example: The clamp-length-invalid helper uses letter-spacing for clamp(0,10rem,100%), while this renderer explicitly supports percentage letter spacing.
findings.action: Review the pinned fixture expectation and dimensional validity before classifying this as a spacing implementation bug.
